'''Zi Sturgist''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] who served aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Although Sturgist technically served as the [[Navy Operations]] [[Chief/Legends|Chief]], he was just an underling of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]].
